row.name: Microsoft Corporation Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 4 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=14 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.19 tightness=0.65 base_volume_vs_leg=0.54 base_volume_vs_avg=0.69
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 0.6% vs its 20-SMA, 3.8% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The chart shows MSFT is on its fourth breakout attempt from a 46-session, 45% move that is clearly extended and aging — the Y criterion hard-fails with three prior breakouts already logged, and the shaded base sits near the top of a multi-month run with price churning sideways in a 500–520 range for roughly six weeks. The burst bar itself is unimpressive: volume came in at only 71% of the prior session and the bar range did not exceed any of the last five bars, meaning there is no genuine expansion of either price range or participation to signal fresh institutional urgency.
claude.key_risk: This is the fourth push out of an aging trend; prior buyers from the first three breakouts are sitting on gains and represent overhead supply that can absorb any rally quickly.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the entry ceiling or if the first 30 minutes show volume tracking below the prior session's pace with no ability to hold above 501.

row.summary: MSFT: +1.6% on 0.7× volume out of a base 6.1% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
